# vaultwarden_organization_group (List Resource)

Lists the groups of an organization, sorted by name. Groups require the `ORG_GROUPS_ENABLED=true` setting on the Vaultwarden server; without it, no groups are listed.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the groups of an organization, and generate import blocks with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
list "vaultwarden_organization_group" "all" {
  provider = vaultwarden

  config {
    organization_id = "<org_id>"
  }
}

# Only groups whose name contains "admins", ignoring case
list "vaultwarden_organization_group" "admins" {
  provider = vaultwarden

  config {
    organization_id = "<org_id>"
    name_contains   = "admins"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization to list the groups of

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Only list the groups whose name contains this text, ignoring case
